title: Paws by the Pond
note: b384 — first use of 'paw_print', 'claw', 'cat', the 'crawl' pose, and the prop opacity option (faint imagined fox).

pages.brief: Ned staring down at a single large paw print in the mud, drawn crisp and clear and considerably bigger than his own foot. Ominous and exciting.
pages.alt: Ned stares down at a single large paw print in the mud, crisp and clear and considerably bigger than his own foot.

pages.brief: The print in close-up: four toe pads and a heel pressed into wet brown mud, water gathering in it. Detailed and slightly menacing.
pages.alt: A close-up of the print: four toe pads and a heel pressed into wet brown mud, with water gathering inside it.

pages.brief: Ned looking around the reeds with wide eyes, imagining — show a faint fox shape suggested in the shadows behind the stems.
pages.alt: Ned looks around the reeds with wide eyes, imagining a faint fox shape suggested in the shadows behind the stems.

pages.brief: Ned crawling forward on his belly through the grass in full stealth mode, only his eyes above the stems. Very funny.
pages.alt: Ned crawls forward on his belly through the grass in full stealth mode, only his eyes above the stems. Very funny.

pages.brief: A single curved claw caught on a grass stem, gleaming, drawn large. Ned's beak inches from it.
pages.alt: A single curved claw is caught on a grass stem, gleaming and drawn large, with Ned's beak just inches from it.

pages.brief: Reveal: a big fat tabby cat lying in the sun beside the pond, entirely harmless and half asleep. Ned's whole body slumping with relief.
pages.alt: A big fat tabby cat is revealed lying in the sun beside the pond, entirely harmless and half asleep, as Ned slumps with relief.

pages.brief: The cat mid-yawn, enormous pink mouth and curled tongue, teeth on full display but comic rather than scary.
pages.alt: The cat is mid-yawn, an enormous pink mouth and curled tongue, teeth on full display but comic rather than scary.

pages.brief: Ned yawning back at the cat, beak wide, in unconscious imitation. The two of them mirroring each other. Charming.
pages.alt: Ned yawns back at the cat in unconscious imitation — the two of them mirroring each other. Charming.

pages.brief: Closing page: pale dawn light over the pond, the cat asleep, Ned waddling off to bed with his eyes already closing.
pages.alt: Closing page: pale dawn light falls over the pond, the cat asleep, as Ned waddles off to bed with his eyes already closing.
